contract.goal: the reactor can be analysed by SonarCloud with one explicit command, with coverage taken from the existing aggregate JaCoCo report
contract.output: root POM: sonar-maven-plugin pinned in pluginManagement plus sonar.host.url, sonar.organization, sonar.projectKey and sonar.coverage.jacoco.xmlReportPaths; Jenkinsfile: a Sonar analysis stage with SONAR_TOKEN from a credential; scripts/check_aggregate_report.py: the Sonar coverage path must match the aggregate report; READMEs in both locales
constraints: no change to ludwig-bom, ludwig-service-parent, .mvn/maven.config or any JaCoCo execution or threshold
the scanner is bound to no lifecycle phase; mvn clean install never contacts SonarCloud
no token or credential in any POM, script or properties file
the analysis itself is not run from this workstation

decisions: sonar.organization=ludwigandreas and sonar.projectKey=LudwigAndreas_java-ludwig-common are inferred from the git remote (SonarCloud's defaults for a GitHub-bound project), not read from SonarCloud. Both are overridable properties.
